title: Morning Briefing: Friday 16 October 2026
excerpt: 14 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.
summary: 14 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.
content_html:
14 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

The stories

  • Rochdale Fitness Group to Undertake 100km Run in Arctic Conditions Rochdale
    Eighteen runners from Resilience gym will tackle a 100km challenge in Swedish Lapland to raise funds for cancer charities, starting January 29, 2027.
  • Jolly Josh welcomes Rochdale families with inclusive play, music and activity sessions Castleton
    The Castleton charity is reaching out to families caring for children and young people with complex medical needs and physical disabilities, with weekly sessions and bookable…
  • Fireworks distributor with Rochdale premises fined £40,000 as fire service takes enforcement action Rochdale
    GMFRS has announced prosecutions over fireworks storage and licensing breaches, including a £40,000 fine for Boom Fireworks, which operates premises in Rochdale.
  • Veterans group calls on Rochdale volunteers to help transform Sea Cadets’ outdoor space Littleborough
    Get Together After Serving, now based at Denehurst Café, is appealing for volunteers, tools and a donated skip to support Rochdale Sea Cadets.
  • Safeguarding concerns, community costs and fireworks raised at Rochdale council meeting Rochdale
    Farooq Ahmed raised concerns about safeguarding powers, while Jordan Tarrant-Short questioned venue costs, fireworks, foster care and Warwick Mill at full council.
  • Future of College Bank Towers Uncertain as Renovation Could Take Over a Decade Rochdale
    Housing chiefs have stated that renovating the College Bank tower blocks would displace residents for more than ten years, with no decision yet made on their future.
  • Heywood and Middleton North MP Visits Redwood School’s Sixth Form at Phoenix Centre Heywood
    Elsie Blundell, MP for Heywood and Middleton North, visited Redwood School’s sixth form at the Phoenix Centre to engage with students and staff about their educational initiatives.
  • Pure 80's Festival 2027 Littleborough
    Pure 80's music festival is back for a third year!!! Rochdale's biggest celebration of everything 80's featuring some of the countries top tribute acts! Littleborough, Denhurst…
  • Springhill Hospice to Host Free Will Information Clinic in Heywood Heywood
    Springhill Hospice is offering a free information clinic for those looking to make or update their wills, with expert guidance available.
  • Rochdale Council to Decide on Housing Development in Bamford Next Week Bamford
    Rochdale Council's planning committee will reconvene on October 22 to make a decision on a proposed housing development on former playing fields in Bamford, following concerns…
  • Volunteers and council team tackle overgrown areas at Middleton’s Jubilee Park Middleton
    The Friends of Jubilee Park and council staff have joined forces for the second phase of work to manage overgrown shrubs and care for the park’s rhododendrons.
  • Inclusive roundabout and zip line feature in plans for new Falinge Park play area Rochdale
    Mayoress Iram Faisal has unveiled plans for new play equipment at Falinge Park, including a wheelchair-accessible roundabout, an inclusive seesaw and a double cableway zip line.

Weather: Partly cloudy 12°C in Rochdale today.

The Morning Briefing is published every day at 9am. Got a story? Tell the newsdesk.
